categoryName: Mobile & tech accessories — chargers, cables, earphones/TWS, power banks, memory cards, screen guards, covers, mouse/keyboard, pen drives

skuLines.line: USB-C PD fast wall charger, 20-25W single port
skuLines.examples: boAt 20W Type-C adapter, Ambrane 20W PD, Portronics Adapto 20, Mi 22.5W
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spike at new-session intake (Mar-Apr, Jul) and Diwali phone-gifting
skuLines.notes: The single highest-turn charging SKU post the USB-C mandate. Stock BIS-marked only — unbranded adapters in wooden hostel blocks are a fire-risk and an insurance argument. Nearest replacement is 30-50 km away, so a stockout means a resident's phone is dead for days.

skuLines.examples: Geep 2.4A, Zebronics ZEB-MA5222, Wox 12W, Erd TC-11
skuLines.notes: Still needed for feature phones, power banks, torches, trimmers and second phones in staff quarters. Do not let this line die just because new phones are USB-C.

skuLines.examples: Mi 67W SonicCharge, Portronics Adapto 65W GaN, Ultraprolink 65W, Ambrane 65W GaN
skuLines.notes: One brick for laptop + phone + earbuds — the right answer for a hostel room with two plug points. Premium end of the shelf; 2-4 pcs depth is enough.

skuLines.line: OEM-equivalent replacement charger for the top campus phone brands
skuLines.examples: Samsung 25W TA800, Realme 33W SuperVOOC-type, Redmi 33W, Oppo/Vivo FlashCharge
skuLines.notes: There is no brand service centre on the hill. Carry 4-6 brand-matched fast chargers or residents make a town trip for a ₹600 item. Beware counterfeit 'original' stock from grey wholesalers.

skuLines.examples: Erd TC-50, Geep keypad charger, Nokia-type AC-3 pin charger
skuLines.notes: Elderly residents, support staff, drivers and kitchen staff run keypad phones. Explicitly excluded from India's USB-C mandate, so this tail does not disappear — and nobody online bothers to serve it well.

skuLines.examples: HP 65W blue-pin, Dell 65W 4.5mm, Lenovo 65W square-tip, Zebronics universal 90W
skuLines.notes: A failed laptop adapter stops a faculty member or a final-year project cold. Keep 1-2 each of the three commonest tips; anything rarer is a 3-day indent, not a stockout.

skuLines.line: Car charger, dual USB / USB-C PD
skuLines.examples: boAt Dual Port 18W, Portronics Car Power 12, Ambrane 20W car charger
skuLines.notes: Every trip off campus is 1-2 hours of hill road each way — institution vehicles, staff cars and taxis all want one. Low depth, steady sale.

skuLines.examples: boAt Wireless Charger 15W, Portronics Toucharge, Ambrane wireless pad
skuLines.notes: Slow mover, keep 1-2 as a shelf-signal that the store carries current tech. Do not over-buy.

skuLines.examples: boAt Type-C A325, Portronics Konnect X 60W, Ambrane RCT15, Mi braided C-to-C
skuLines.notes: After the June-2025 USB-C mandate this is THE cable SKU. Braided outlasts PVC in a humid hill climate where sheathing goes sticky and connectors corrode. Stock deep — cables are the single most-replaced accessory.

skuLines.examples: Geep Type-C 2.4A, Erd UC-21, Zebronics ZEB-UCC100
skuLines.notes: The ₹99 impulse cable. Highest unit velocity and best percentage margin on the shelf; keep a hanging strip at the counter.

skuLines.examples: Geep micro-USB high-speed, Portronics Konnect A, Erd UC-11
skuLines.notes: Keypad phones, older Android, power banks, Bluetooth speakers, trimmers, torches, toys. A shrinking but stubborn tail — hold roughly a third of the depth you give Type-C.

skuLines.line: Lightning cable (iPhone), MFi or good third-party
skuLines.examples: Apple Lightning-to-USB-C 1m, boAt LTG 500, Ambrane MFi Lightning
skuLines.notes: Small but high-value cohort: senior faculty, administration, visiting trustees. One MFi and one value option is enough; cheap Lightning cables fail fast and come back as complaints.

skuLines.examples: boAt 3-in-1, Portronics Konnect Trio, Ambrane 3-in-1
skuLines.notes: One cable for a family with three different phones — a genuinely good fit for staff quarters. Explain the lower charging speed so it does not come back.

skuLines.examples: boAt 2m Type-C, Portronics 2m braided, Ambrane 3m
skuLines.notes: Hostel-specific insight: the socket is on the far wall and the bed is not. A 2m cable is the item hostel residents ask for and general stores never carry.

skuLines.examples: boAt AUX 1m, Portronics Konnect L, Zebronics AUX, Type-C-to-3.5mm dongle
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes around functions, gurpurabs, sports days
skuLines.notes: Every phone without a jack plus every hall/car/speaker with only a jack. The dongle is a constant small-value sale and the item people are angriest about not finding.

skuLines.examples: Zebronics HDMI 1.5m, Ultraprolink HDMI 2.0, Portronics Mport, generic C-to-HDMI
skuLines.notes: Classroom projectors and smart boards at Akal Academy and Eternal University. Sells to departments on indent as much as to walk-ins — worth a small institutional pack size.

skuLines.line: LAN / Ethernet patch cable 1-10m (and RJ45 connectors)
skuLines.examples: D-Link Cat6 patch, Terabyte Cat6, Amazon Basics Cat6
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; after monsoon lightning damage
skuLines.notes: Campus hostels and offices still run wired LAN where Wi-Fi is weak in stone/concrete blocks. Cat6 only; keep 3m and 5m as the fast movers and longer runs on order.

skuLines.line: OTG adapter (USB-C / micro-USB to USB-A) + microSD card reader
skuLines.examples: SanDisk OTG adapter, Hespa dual OTG connector, Portronics Mport 2
skuLines.notes: Cheap, tiny, no shelf cost, and it is the difference between a student submitting a file and not. Pair on the shelf with pen drives.

skuLines.examples: Zebronics 4-port hub, Portronics Mport 4, Ultraprolink 6-in-1 hub
skuLines.notes: Modern thin laptops have two ports. Keep one cheap hub and one powered multiport dock; the dock also serves labs and the admin office.

skuLines.examples: Ambrane Stylo Neo, boAt Energyshroom PB300, Mi Power Bank 3i, URBN 10000
skuLines.notes: Power banks are India's fastest-growing accessory segment (~10.4% CAGR) precisely because of outage-prone locations like this one. BIS CRS registration is mandatory (IS 16046 Pt.2 / IS 13252) — refuse uncertified stock. Lithium cells lose usable capacity in cold; store above freezing and rotate, they self-discharge on the shelf.

skuLines.examples: Ambrane 20000 22.5W, boAt 20000, Mi Power Bank 4i 33W, Redmi 20000
skuLines.notes: Becoming the mass SKU as prices fall. One unit charges a family's phones through an evening outage. Bulky and heavy — a real freight-cost line on a hill route.

skuLines.line: Pocket power bank 5,000mAh with built-in cable
skuLines.examples: Ambrane Pocket, boAt Energyshroom PB250, Mivi mini
skuLines.notes: Fits a pocket on a day trip to town. Built-in cable means one less thing forgotten — the right SKU for students and for hospital/travel kits.

skuLines.line: Extension board / spike guard with surge protection + USB sockets
skuLines.examples: Goldmedal 4+4, Anchor Penta multi-plug, Wipro 4-socket surge, Belkin spike guard
skuLines.notes: Hostel rooms fight over plug points — the most-quoted hostel essential in every Indian packing list. Also the cheapest insurance against hill-feeder voltage swings that kill laptop adapters. Sell surge-protected, not the ₹80 bare strip.

skuLines.examples: Eveready rechargeable torch, Wipro emergency LED lamp, Syska rechargeable light
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter outages; Oct-Feb dark evenings
skuLines.notes: Overlaps the electricals shelf, but it is the same buyer in the same visit. In a hill township with unlit paths between blocks and frequent cuts, this is not a novelty item.

skuLines.line: AA/AAA alkaline cells, plus rechargeable NiMH + cell charger
skuLines.examples: Duracell AA/AAA, Eveready Ultima, Amazon Basics rechargeable, Panasonic Eneloop
skuLines.notes: Remotes, wall clocks, blood-pressure monitors, toys, mics, weighing scales. Shelf life 5-10 years on alkaline so overstock is not a spoilage risk — the one battery line you can buy deep. Rechargeables are the honest answer for high-drain classroom mics.

skuLines.line: Button cells — CR2032/CR2025, watch and hearing-aid cells
skuLines.examples: Maxell CR2032, Panasonic CR2025, Renata watch cells, Rayovac hearing-aid 675
skuLines.notes: Tiny, high-margin, zero shelf cost — and for an elderly resident whose hearing aid or wrist watch has died, the alternative is a 60-100 km round trip. Classic captive-market line.

skuLines.examples: boAt Bassheads 100, Ambrane EP-56, pTron Boom Ultima, Zebronics Buds
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes at session start and online-exam periods
skuLines.notes: The volume audio SKU: cheap enough to replace, no battery to die, and permitted where TWS is not. Language labs, online tests, viva calls, kitchen and security staff. Stock several price points including a genuine ₹149 one.

skuLines.examples: boAt Bassheads 232 Type-C, Realme Buds Wired Type-C, pTron Type-C
skuLines.notes: New phones have no headphone jack, and a Type-C wired pair beats a dongle plus earphones. Rising share every year as the installed base turns over.

skuLines.examples: boAt Airdopes 121v2/131, pTron Bassbuds, Boult Z20, Mivi DuoPods
skuLines.notes: Headphones are 32.8% of India's accessory market and boAt alone ~33% of TWS. Entry prices compressed ~18% since 2025, so quality at ₹999 is now real. Bluetooth 5.3+, IPX4/5 and Type-C case charging are the minimum specs to accept.

skuLines.examples: boAt Airdopes Plus, Noise Buds series, OnePlus Nord Buds, realme Buds T-series
skuLines.notes: ANC is now standard above ~₹1,999 and demand for it in the sub-₹3,000 band grew ~35% in H1-2025. Two SKUs is enough depth; this is the aspirational end of the shelf and the reason a resident does not order online instead.

skuLines.examples: boAt Rockerz 255, Noise Nerve, pTron Tangent, Boult Curve
skuLines.notes: Still the working man's wireless: 20-30 hours on a charge, does not fall out, cheap to replace. Drivers, maintenance, security and farm/garden staff prefer these to buds.

skuLines.examples: boAt Rockerz 450, Zebronics Duke, JBL Tune 510BT, Portronics Muffs
skuLines.notes: Music students, media/recording work, long study sessions, and the winter months when in-ear is uncomfortable. Keep 1-2 SKUs.

skuLines.line: Headset with boom mic (USB / 3.5mm / BT) for classes and calls
skuLines.examples: Zebronics ZEB-100HMV, Logitech H111, boAt Immortal-type gaming headset
skuLines.seasonality: Term time; online-exam and viva weeks
skuLines.notes: Online classes, recorded lectures, telephonic interviews, university placement calls, and the admin front desk. A clear mic matters more than the audio here — sell on that.

skuLines.examples: boAt Stone 190/350, Zebronics Bombs, JBL Go 4, Mivi Roam
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurabs, functions, sports days, picnics; year-round in quarters
skuLines.notes: Rooms, canteens, small gatherings, morning kirtan in quarters, PT and sports announcements. IPX rating matters in a monsoon location. A hostel-favourite item that is also a legitimate institutional buy.

skuLines.line: Gurbani / Nitnem player — Bluetooth + FM + SD card, preloaded tracks
skuLines.examples: Preloaded Gurbani radio player (Nitnem, Sukhmani Sahib, Sehaj Path), Singh/Kaur BT Gurbani radio, small Sikh MP3 kirtan player
skuLines.packSizes: 1 pc, usually boxed as a gift
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurabs, Vaisakhi, Bandi Chhor Divas, Prakash Parv; gifting season
skuLines.notes: The most site-specific line in this whole category. A Kalgidhar Trust township of 5,000 with residential staff families and elderly residents is exactly the buyer for a preloaded Nitnem player — for daily use, for parents, and as the default respectful gift. These are almost never on a general store's shelf and never on q-commerce. Stock 2-3 tiers and keep the FM+torch+recording variants, which elderly users actually use.

skuLines.line: Preloaded / blank memory card for Gurbani and MP3 players, and pocket FM radio
skuLines.examples: 8-32GB card loaded with Gurbani or Katha tracks, small FM radio with SD slot
skuLines.notes: Pairs with the Gurbani player above and with car stereos. Loading a card is a 5-minute service the store can charge for; keep the content strictly to freely distributable Gurbani/Katha recordings and avoid copyrighted film music.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable collar/handheld mic and small portable PA
skuLines.examples: Ahuja portable PA, generic rechargeable UHF collar mic, waistband voice amplifier
skuLines.seasonality: Academic term, assemblies, sports days, annual functions
skuLines.notes: A teacher addressing 40 children in a stone classroom, plus assemblies and functions. Mostly a departmental/indent sale, but the AA cells, spare mic cables and chargers it drags along are counter sales all year.

skuLines.examples: SanDisk Ultra 64GB, Samsung EVO Plus 64GB, Strontium Nitro 32GB
skuLines.notes: Thin, price-transparent margins — customers know the online price, so sell on availability not price. Counterfeit SanDisk is rampant in the wholesale channel; buy only from an authorised distributor and keep the warranty slip. Never store loose in a humid godown.

skuLines.examples: SanDisk Ultra 128GB, Samsung EVO Plus 128GB, SanDisk Extreme 128GB, Samsung Pro Endurance for CCTV
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; after any CCTV/camera install
skuLines.notes: The endurance-rated variant is the one CCTV and dashcams need and the one nobody stocks — a standing institutional line for campus security. Verify capacity on receipt; fake high-capacity cards are the commonest fraud in this line.

skuLines.examples: SanDisk Cruzer Blade 32GB, HP v236w 64GB, Sony 32GB, Strontium 64GB
skuLines.seasonality: Assignment and exam submission periods; project season (Feb-Apr)
skuLines.notes: Still the way work moves between a hostel laptop, a lab PC and a printout shop when the campus network is slow. Frequently lost, so repeat purchase is high. School students buy these too.

skuLines.examples: SanDisk Ultra Dual Drive Go 128GB, SanDisk Type-C 128GB, HP 128GB
skuLines.notes: Dual-ended (phone + laptop) is the one students actually want. Two SKUs is plenty of depth.

skuLines.examples: SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD 500GB, WD Elements 1TB, Seagate Expansion 1TB, Crucial X6
skuLines.notes: Faculty research, media/photography department, exam-record and CCTV backups. Slow-moving high-ticket — hold 1-2, treat the rest as indent-only. Not an impulse SKU; the value is having one the day a hard disk dies.

skuLines.examples: Zebronics card reader, Portronics Mport C3, generic all-in-one reader
skuLines.notes: Needed to pull camera and CCTV cards, and to load Gurbani players. Cheap, small, good margin, and it feeds the store's own data-transfer service.

skuLines.line: Tempered glass screen guard — the top 15-25 handset models on campus
skuLines.examples: 9H tempered glass for Redmi/Realme/Samsung M-series/vivo/Oppo current models; full-glue edge-to-edge
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes after new phone purchases (Diwali, session start)
skuLines.notes: Protective cases and glass are India's most volume-intensive accessory categories (~18.7% of market value) and the best-margin line here — but they are model-locked, and that is the trap. Do not buy an assortment; count the actual handsets in circulation on campus first, hold only the live models, and treat any model older than ~2 years as dead stock to clear. Cracked-screen repair is 50 km away, which is exactly why residents buy glass.

skuLines.line: Universal / cut-to-size screen guard, plus tablet and laptop guards
skuLines.examples: Universal 6.5" PET guard, tablet 10.1" tempered glass, laptop 15.6" anti-glare/privacy film
skuLines.notes: The answer for the odd handset you have no model-specific glass for, and for tablets used in classrooms. Universal film plus in-store pasting turns a stockout into a sale.

skuLines.line: Back cover / silicone TPU case — top campus models, plain and printed
skuLines.examples: Plain matte TPU for current Redmi/Realme/Samsung/vivo, transparent shockproof, printed designer covers
skuLines.notes: Cases have moved from protection to lifestyle — printed and pastel designs sell to students at 2-3x the plain price. Same model-lock discipline as glass: narrow model list, deep in the live ones. Keep designs modest given the institutional setting.

skuLines.line: Rugged/armour case and flip wallet cover (premium)
skuLines.examples: Spigen-style armour case, MTB armour, flip wallet cover for popular models
skuLines.notes: Real value on stone floors and hill trekking. Flip covers appeal to older staff who keep cards and cash in them.

skuLines.examples: Universal IPX8 phone pouch with lanyard, zip-lock dry pouch, 2-pc pack
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon (Jun-Sep) — heavy in Sirmaur; also travel
skuLines.notes: A location-specific must-have that a plains store treats as a novelty. Heavy monsoon plus open walkways between blocks means soaked phones every July. Pre-monsoon push in late May/June; near-zero sale in winter, so buy seasonally not annually.

skuLines.line: Device cleaning kit — microfibre, screen spray, air blower, brush
skuLines.examples: Screen-cleaning gel kit, 2-pc microfibre, rocket air blower, keyboard brush
skuLines.notes: Humidity plus dust on hill roads clogs ports and speakers. Cheap, non-perishable, good margin, and it supports the laptop-cleaning service.

skuLines.examples: Dell MS116, HP m10, Logitech B100, Zebronics Comfort
skuLines.notes: Computer labs, offices and every hostel laptop user who hates the trackpad. Dies often, cheap to replace, and a lab of 40 machines is a standing institutional order — the single most reliable peripheral line.

skuLines.examples: Logitech M170/M235, Dell MS3320W, HP 250, Zebronics Dash
skuLines.notes: Sell the AA cell with it — that pairing is where the margin sits. Logitech's warranty is claimable by courier, which matters at this PIN.

skuLines.examples: Dell KB216, HP 100, Zebronics K-35, Logitech MK240 wireless combo
skuLines.notes: Offices, labs, accounts and library counters. Keep one wired budget SKU, one wireless combo. Hindi/Punjabi-marked keycaps are worth asking about for local data entry.

skuLines.examples: Zebronics NC1500 cooling pad, Cosmic Byte cooling pad, aluminium laptop stand
skuLines.notes: Bulky for hill freight relative to its value — keep 1-2 pieces, do not build a wall of them.

skuLines.examples: AmazonBasics 15.6" sleeve, Dell Essential backpack, HP laptop backpack, waterproof rain-cover backpack
skuLines.notes: Pick the versions with a rain cover — students carry laptops across open campus in Sirmaur monsoon. Overlaps the clothing store's bag shelf; decide which counter owns it so it is not bought twice.

skuLines.line: Webcam 1080p, plus ring light / phone tripod
skuLines.examples: Logitech C270, Zebronics Zeb-Crisp Pro, 10" ring light with tripod, mini tripod
skuLines.seasonality: Term time; online-class and recorded-lecture periods; admission interviews
skuLines.notes: Recorded lectures, online classes, placement interviews and the institution's own media/outreach work. Genuinely useful and rarely available locally.

skuLines.line: Mobile holder — tripod, selfie stick, gooseneck bed mount, car mount
skuLines.examples: Tripod 3110, boAt selfie stick, gooseneck flexible clamp holder, dashboard mount
skuLines.notes: Impulse-priced, high margin, no model lock, no shelf life. The gooseneck bed mount is a hostel favourite; the tripod also serves student video assignments.

skuLines.line: Wi-Fi router, range extender and USB Wi-Fi dongle
skuLines.examples: TP-Link TL-WR841N, D-Link N300, TP-Link RE200 extender, TP-Link USB Wi-Fi adapter
skuLines.notes: Staff quarters and hostel wings with weak coverage through thick walls. Routers die in lightning season — which is both the demand driver and the reason to sell a surge board alongside. Configuration is a chargeable service.

skuLines.line: Smartwatch straps (20/22mm) and an entry smartwatch
skuLines.examples: Silicone/metal 20mm and 22mm straps, Noise ColorFit, boAt Wave, Fire-Boltt entry
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali and gifting; New Year fitness resolve
skuLines.notes: The straps are the real business — every smartwatch on campus needs one within a year, they are model-agnostic at 20/22mm, and nobody stocks them. Carry the watch itself shallow.

skuLines.examples: Universal LED TV remote, Tata Play and Airtel DTH replacement remotes
skuLines.notes: Staff quarters and common rooms. Drags an AAA cell sale with it every time. Trivial to stock, and the alternative for the resident is a town trip.

skuLines.line: USB desk fan / USB LED reading light / gooseneck lamp
skuLines.examples: USB mini table fan, USB clip LED light, rechargeable book light
skuLines.seasonality: USB fan Apr-Jun; reading lights Oct-Feb and through outages
skuLines.notes: Hostel-room comfort items that run off a power bank when the supply goes. Two clean seasonal pushes rather than a year-round shelf.

skuLines.line: Small-parts counter bin — SIM ejector, SIM adapter, earphone tips, cable protectors, dust plugs, phone stands
skuLines.examples: SIM ejector pin, nano-to-micro SIM adapter set, silicone eartip 3-size pack, cable-saver spring
skuLines.notes: Individually trivial, collectively the best-margin footage at the counter, and each one is an item a resident would otherwise travel 30-50 km for. Sell from a single tray with visible ₹ tags rather than as catalogued SKUs.

trends2026: USB-C is now the law, not a preference: MeitY's common-charger mandate covers phones and tablets sold from June 2025 and laptops by end-2026 (dumbphones, watches and earbuds exempt). Practical effect on this shelf — C-to-C 60W braided cable becomes the single default cable SKU, Lightning shrinks to a faculty/iPhone tail, and micro-USB survives only for feature phones, power banks and torches.

Budget TWS crossed a quality floor and kept falling: entry prices compressed ~18% since 2025 on local manufacturing, ANC is now standard above ~₹1,999 (demand for ANC under ₹3,000 up ~35% in H1-2025), and Bluetooth 5.3+, 10-13mm drivers, IPX4/5 and 35-50h case battery are the 2026 minimum spec to accept from a supplier.

Power banks are India's fastest-growing accessory segment (~10.4% CAGR, 13.9% of market value), and the growth is explicitly outage-driven rural/tier-3 demand — 20,000mAh at 22.5W is becoming the mass SKU where 10,000mAh was.
GaN multi-port chargers at ₹999-1,500 are displacing single-port bricks: one 65W charger for laptop + phone + buds is the 2026 buying pattern, which suits a hostel room with two working sockets.

BIS compliance is tightening around exactly the lines a store like this stocks: power banks and lithium-battery devices need CRS registration (IS 13252 Pt.1 / IS 16046 Pt.2), rated-capacity verification became mandatory from 3 Feb 2026, and IS/IEC 62368-1:2023 is replacing the older device-electronics standards. Uncertified loose stock is now a legal and insurance exposure, not just a quality one.

Protective cases and screen guards have shifted from protection to lifestyle — printed, pastel and personalised covers at 2-3x plain-case prices — while remaining the most volume-intensive accessory category (~18.7% of value) and the most model-locked inventory risk.

Earbuds are gaining wellness sensors (heart rate, SpO2) and LED touch-screen charging cases as the ₹3,000+ differentiator, and D2C brands now hold ~80% of the entry segment with new models every ~90 days — so model churn, not brand churn, is what strands stock.

Online is 58.4% of India's mobile-accessory market with Amazon and Flipkart taking 45-48% of revenue. For a captive township store the strategic read is that price competition is already lost and irrelevant — the defensible edge is same-hour availability of the ₹99-₹999 item nobody wants to wait 3-5 days at a 173101 PIN for.
adjacentServices: Tempered-glass and screen-guard pasting — ₹50-100 labour on a ₹150 part, bubble-free, done at the counter. Turns universal film into a sale when the model-specific glass is out of stock.

Mobile and laptop repair as a collect-and-return desk: log the device, courier or carry it to a technician in Rajgarh/Nahan/Solan, return in 3-5 days. The store never repairs anything; it removes a 60-100 km round trip. Charge a handling fee, hold a signed receipt.

Warranty/RMA handling on behalf of residents — brand courier claims (Logitech, boAt, SanDisk, Ambrane) are unusable from a remote PIN without someone to package and track them. This is the service that justifies buying branded rather than loose stock.

Memory-card and player loading — Gurbani/Nitnem and Katha tracks onto SD cards for elderly residents' players and car stereos, plus phone-to-phone data transfer and backup before a device goes for repair. Keep strictly to freely distributable devotional recordings.
Router, Wi-Fi extender and printer setup in staff quarters; laptop cleaning, Windows reinstall and antivirus. Small ₹200-500 jobs that pull the peripheral sale with them.

Print, photocopy, scan and passport photo at the same counter — it shares the pen drive, card reader, cable and cartridge inventory, and it is the reason a student walks in with a pen drive in the first place.
Charging and locker station in the canteens, and short-term rental of power banks, extension boards and headsets during exam weeks, sports meets and trips.

Institutional bulk supply on internal indent — mouse, keyboard, LAN patch cables, HDMI, extension boards, endurance microSD for CCTV, collar mics — for Eternal University labs and Akal Academy classrooms. Different pack sizes and a PO channel, not a walk-in shelf.
Old-charger/cable exchange and an e-waste collection bin. Cheap goodwill, an EPR-compliant disposal route for a township with no other one, and it clears dead model-locked stock as trade-in credit.

Pre-monsoon and session-start kit bundles: a waterproof pouch + surge board + long cable + torch as one priced bundle in June, and a hostel starter kit (extension board, 2m cable, wired earphones, pen drive, mouse) in July-August.
